findings.explanation: Line 0 (Creme fraiche 34%) is billed at 10.5 l, but delivery note DN-0112 records 8.5 l. The contract limits charges to the receipted amounts, so the billed quantity appears to exceed what was received.
findings.quote: the receipted amounts are the only amounts that may be charged
